heroHeadline: IDF Pushes Past Yellow Line in Gaza; Cabinet Approves Military Compound at UNRWA Site; ICC Denies Warrants Issued
heroSubtitle: Israeli forces conducted multiple airstrikes across Gaza on May 18, 2026, killing at least 8 Palestinians including a drone strike on Deir al-Balah. Prime Minister Netanyahu signaled to the cabinet that IDF forces are 'actively pushing past the Yellow Line' — the October 2025 ceasefire demarcation boundary — representing a de facto territorial expansion. The Israeli cabinet voted to build a military compound at the former UNRWA headquarters site in Gaza, furthering the permanent exclusion of the UN relief agency. The ICC's official spokesperson denied that new sealed arrest warrants have been 'issued' for Smotrich, Ben-Gvir, Strock, and two IDF officials — clarifying that the prosecutor's application is before Pre-Trial Chamber I but warrants have not yet been formally issued; the May 17 Haaretz report citing a diplomatic source remains disputed. The Gaza death toll stands at 72,757+ since October 7, 2023, with ~910+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, as Hamas disarmament talks remain at an impasse.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OCHA, IDF, Gaza Ministry of Health, B'Tselem, ICC, ICJ, Reuters, Al Jazeera, OHCHR, UNRWA, Times of Israel, Haaretz, Bloomberg, Jerusalem Post, Human Rights Watch, Save the Children, Amnesty International, UNICEF, NPR, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are subject to ongoing verification. The conflict has persisted since Israeli independence on May 14, 1948.
